strings.name: Li Ka-shing
strings.role: Cheung Kong founder · Entrepreneur and philanthropist
strings.summary: Li Ka-shing began in plastics manufacturing and expanded Cheung Kong and Hutchison businesses into property, ports, retail, telecommunications and infrastructure. His international investments helped shape Hong Kong’s business networks. After retiring as group chairman in 2018, he devoted more attention to his foundation’s education and medical work; business achievements and medical outcomes require separate assessment.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026, including a 2026 medical-assistance program. He retired as group chairman in 2018. Funding a treatment program does not guarantee clinical outcomes.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed Cheung Kong and Hutchison businesses, investing internationally in ports, telecommunications, retail and infrastructure.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education or early career
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Moved to Hong Kong during wartime and left school early to work
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: International business network
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Expanded from manufacturing into property and Hutchison, building businesses across sectors and countries.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Education and medical support
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Established a foundation in 1980, supporting universities, research and medical services.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Liver-cancer treatment subsidy
strings.timeline.event-1.text: The foundation launched histotripsy assistance, subject to clinical and financial eligibility checks.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Retires as group chairman
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Left the CK Hutchison and CK Asset chairmanships, becoming senior adviser and focusing more on philanthropy.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Corporate restructuring
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Reorganized Cheung Kong and Hutchison businesses into structures including CK Hutchison and CK Property.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Supports Shantou University
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Helped establish the university and continued supporting its development and education programs.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Foundation established
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Made education and medicine long-term philanthropic priorities.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Hutchison Whampoa stake acquired
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Entered a major diversified group and subsequently expanded internationally.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Cheung Kong listed
strings.timeline.event-7.text: As business shifted from manufacturing toward property, the company entered public markets.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Cheung Kong plastics founded
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Wartime move to Hong Kong
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Left Chaozhou with his family because of war and later left school to work.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in Chaozhou
